|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/yebyebademthorn.html</ref>

With his trade agenda, he works well with [[This Is Outrageous!]] by allowing you to exchange cards you don't need from your hand for (hopefully) better cards in your Lost Pile. And with his wealth agenda, he allows you to fully utilize [[Motion Supported]] to enhance your battle destinies. But the rest of his game text is what sets him apart from the rest of the senators. Looking at your opponent's destinies would be a very useful ability by itself. It lets you decide whether it would be a good idea to battle since you check whether your opponent's weapon destinies will be dangerous to you, or if you can handle that draw against you for battle destiny. But Yeb Yeb goes further by tilting the tides of chance in your favor. If the destiny is low, you can leave it on your opponent's Reserve Deck, but if it's a high destiny you can make it lost and try your luck with the next card.
